exposure: women carrying a fetus with aEFW ≥ 4000 g
cohort: Derivation cohort: 686 singleton vaginal deliveries (131 with shoulder dystocia). Validation cohort: 2584 deliveries (31 with shoulder dystocia)
finding: A machine learning model developed for the prediction of shoulder dystocia outperformed estimated fetal weight, either alone or combined with maternal diabetes, in predicting shoulder dystocia.
